input: Any commit that modifies /moves/bishop_c8.text must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to bishop_c8's own key, since bishop_c8 has now gone off plan (panic), while the existing twelve-signature rule continues to apply to every other piece.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("12", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/bishop_c8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false)
